visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: Zero is calculated every time
visualizerParams.problemDescription: Calling the function with 0 several times does the work every time, though the cache should answer. The answer for 0 is 0, which counts as empty.

solution.explanation: if (cache[n]) is false for a saved answer of 0 (and for an empty string or false), so the answer is lost. Test whether the key exists with the in operator instead of testing the value.
